Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter (Project Ibis)

Dear Mr. Rathore,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 February 2022 about your dispute with M/s Iyer Marine Ltd. As we understand it, the vessel is about to leave port. The matter is listed before the Calcutta High Court.

Our advice is to arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim. Please collect the salvage agreement and the logbook entries and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹14,03,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
